stories.summary: A group of devotees, mostly women, allegedly broke the lock on the entrance gate of a lake in Maharashtra's Palghar district after authorities prohibited Chhath Puja celebrations at the site, police said on Sunday. stories.summary: Anand Chaini Pune: Jambhulwadi Lake in Katraj witnessed a vibrant display of faith and devotion on Sunday evening as devotees gathered to celebrate Chhath Puja. Women dressed in colourful traditional sarees stood knee-deep in the water, holding bamboo baskets and plates filled with fruits, flowers and other offerings as they offered prayers to the setting Sun.

stories.title: What Is Usha Arghaya? Dos And Donts To Follow On The Fourth Day Of Chhath Mahaparv
stories.summary: Puja is a four-day festival marked by fasting, holy bathing, a disciplined lifestyle, purity of mind and body, and deep devotion. On the final day, devotees gather before dawn to offer Usha Arghya to the rising Sun.
